title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-1 Art & Culture PART-3

questions.question: Akham Lakshmi Devi, a recipient of the Sangeet Natak Akademi award, is renowned for which of the following dances?
Kathak is found in three distinct forms, called ‘gharanas’, named after the cities where the Kathak dance tradition evolved. Name those three cities.
Padma Bhushan awardee, Alarmel Velli, who is renowned for Bharatanatyam, is also an exponent of which of the following dance forms?
Bhortal dance is famous in _________.
Which of the following groups of classical dancers is related to Kathak?
questions.option_1: Alarmel Valli, Malavika Sarukkai and Sucheta Chaphekar
questions.option_2: Kumkum Mohanty, Sonal Mansingh and Kiran Sehgal
questions.option_3: Sitara Devi, Shaswati Sen and Urmila Nagar
questions.option_4: Yamini Krishnamurthy, Shobha Naidu and Swapnasundari
